content.name: pingsCount
content.description: The amount of pings required to trigger a moderation action.

content.name: enableRolePingThresholds
content.description: If enabled, specific roles can have custom ping thresholds for this moderation action. This also allows specific roles to be exempted from this specific action.

content.name: rolePingThresholds
content.description: Set custom ping thresholds per role for this moderation action. If a user has multiple configured roles, the value of their highest configured role is used. Setting a role to 0 exempts that role from this action - exempted roles also override any other role's threshold.

content.name: useCustomTimeframe
content.description: If enabled, you can choose your own custom timeframe of days in which the pings must occur to trigger the moderation action.

content.name: timeframeDays
content.description: In how many days must these pings occur?

content.name: muteDuration
content.humanName: Mute Duration (only if action type is MUTE)
content.description: How long to mute the user? (in minutes)

content.name: enableActionLogging
content.description: If enabled, moderation actions will be logged in the channel where a protected user/role got pinged.

content.name: actionLogMessage
content.description: The message that will be sent when a user is punished for pinging protected users/roles.

params.name: pinger-mention
params.description: Mention of the user who pinged

params.name: pinger-name
params.description: Name of the user who pinged

params.name: pings
params.description: Number of pings that triggered the action

params.name: timeframe
params.description: The timeframe in days in which the pings occurred

params.name: duration
params.description: Duration of the mute in minutes (only for the mute action)

default.title: Moderation action taken against %pinger-name%
default.description:
I have taken action against %pinger-mention% for pinging protected users/roles %pings% times within %timeframe% days.
 **Action:** %action%
**Duration:** %duration% minutes
